creator: stilesai
topic: Do not build one Claude skill per saved reel; pool saved reels and freebies into one knowledge base, compare, keep the best, and stack into one setup

says.claim: Making one skill per saved reel is wrong; consolidate everything you have saved, compare overlapping advice, keep the best version, and stack the skills into one setup.
steps: Sort your saved reels into collections (editing, marketing, yours)
Step 1: put everything in one place, saved reels plus every freebie sent to your DMs, as one knowledge base or Claude project
Step 2: have Claude compare everything; if five creators teach the same thing keep the version that works and drop the rest
Step 3: stack the kept skills into one setup (e.g. Script, Hooks, Edit, Captions, Sound)
Start a project with that setup so it already knows the playbook; works for marketing, sales, school
says.proof_shown: None beyond his own claim that his Claude setup is built this way; diagrams are illustrative ('EXAMPLE' tags on the DM and comment mockups)

freebie.promised: the full guide, auto-sent by DM; he also offers free setup help by message

hook.visual: Face in the lower 60% of frame on a cream background, pixel-art blue robot mascot top-center holding a phone

does.captions: Uppercase monospace, white text in a solid black box, 2 to 4 words at a time, centered at the graphic/face seam; step tags are red boxes top-center; handwritten red script annotations ('wrong', 'save this one', 'never opened', 'not happening').
does.graphics: Flat pixel-art mascot and UI-card diagrams drawn to match the spoken line, new graphic roughly every 1.5 to 3 seconds; labeled 'EXAMPLE' on fake DMs and comments.
does.palette: Cream background, black, cobalt blue, with red and yellow accents

pace.visual_changes_per_10s: 4 to 6 (graphic swaps every 1.5 to 3s even though hard cuts are few)
